title: feat: formatNumber in Stats widget
body:
I've added `_formatNumber` to Hogan templates. It is also available through `search.templateHelpers.formatNumber` (`search` being the `instantsearch.js` instance).

I've updated all other widgets to accept the new `widget.render` syntax.

I'll update the other widgets (to use the `formatNumber` in prices and facet counts) after this PR is merged. I currently need to pass the `templateHelper` from instant search to the widget, then to the component, then to the template which is not optimal, though.

Also fixes #82 since the new render API is option object based

comments.body:
I agree that the `_` might not be the best way, but the alternative of putting it in `helpers` makes templates very verbose `{{#helpers.formatNumber}}{{nbHits}}{{/helpers.formatNumber}}`. Don't know which is best.

Anyway, I think we should chose one of the two ways and not both.

> makes templates very verbose {{#helpers.formatNumber}}{{nbHits}}{{/helpers.formatNumber}}. Don't know which is best.

Yes, then you would have to put `{{hit.attr}}` everywhere right? Dunno what would work the best and what would be the easiest to use.
Can you write the documentation already (we miss a ## template part where we talk in general about templates.
Nope, we'll still be able to reference `{{nbHits}}` directly, the `helpers.` syntax will only be for formatters like this one

> helpers. syntax will only be for formatters like this one

Oh so I guess `helpers.formatNumber` looks better than `_formateNumber`?
Ok for the longer `helpers.nameOfTheHelper` then. I'll update the PR with the changes.
Done. Will update other widgets after this PR.
@pixelastic I think we are good here, we merge and then add the check on already present properties when the js client do clone the hits.
